newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Coast Guard approves ARVAK as COFR guarantor.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Coast Guard approves ARVAK as COFR guarantor.

text.p: The U.S. Coast Guard National Pollution Funds Center said Thursday it approved Arvak Limited (ARVAK) to provide "other evidence" of financial responsibility for vessel owners and operators for potential water pollution liabilities.
Arvak, an insurer licensed under laws of Bermuda, was approved to provide other evidence of financial responsibility for up to $395 million, the Coast Guard said.
Arvak is reinsured through an extensive program with reinsurers in London, it said.

The 1990 Oil Pollution Act requires vessel operators in U.S. waters to have evidence of their ability to pay for removal costs and certain other damages from a spill of oil or other hazardous substances.
A vessel that complies with this is issued a certificate of financial responsibilty (COFR).
